subject: Embeddings & Rerank: Staged delta cutover and vectorstore compatibility checklist
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@nimbo-pay.com>, Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@nimbo-pay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embeddings & Rerank: Staged delta cutover and vectorstore compatibility checklist

Samir / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, NimbusPay is planning a phased migration from your legacy search stack to the new Redwood embeddings + rerank pipeline. To keep the cutover low-risk while preserving query quality, I sketched a staged "delta" approach that only backfills high-impact segments first (transactions, receipts, refund flows) and leaves bulk archival content for wave 2.

Attached is a working timeline and a compatibility matrix for the two vectorstores you flagged in the RFP. Ask/next steps for us to get started:
- Review the timeline and mark any hard blackout windows for your infra/ops team.
- Confirm the two sample datasets we should use for rerank evals (I suggested transaction-logs and help-center Q&A).
- Share your retention/KMS constraints so we can complete the security questionnaire section for Private deployments.

I'll coordinate the first engineering sync once we have the sample datasets and the preferred ETA for a staging run. Marissa, Neha — looping you for implementation owner alignment and to confirm the runbook roles. Grace, would you take the lead on rerank eval criteria?

Files attached: 2026-05-11_nimbus_delta_cutover_timeline.xlsx; vectorstore_compat_matrix.pdf

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank: Staged delta cutover and vectorstore compatibility checklist

Samir / Aisha — thanks Rafael. Quick notes from an implementation perspective:

- Staged delta approach: we agree this minimizes regressions. For wave 1 backfill we suggest a 14-day overlap period where traffic is shadowed to both systems while we collect rerank telemetry.
- Vectorstore compatibility: the compatibility matrix flags two areas of concern for Vendor X (sharding + incremental upsert performance). If you can confirm expected QPS per shard we can size a recommended instance profile.
- Data pipeline: two ingestion patterns matter — (a) incremental real-time events (transactions) and (b) bulk historical load. We'll give you separate runbooks for each.

Action items from our side: I'll publish the implementation runbook draft and a checklist for your infra team by EOD Wednesday. Neha will surface our recommended smoke tests for rerank quality (precision@5, MRR on golden queries). Grace, please indicate which prompt sets you want included in the initial eval set.

Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank: Staged delta cutover and vectorstore compatibility checklist

On Tue, May 11, 2026 at 11:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Samir / Aisha — thanks Rafael. Quick notes from an implementation perspective:
>
> - Staged delta approach: we agree this minimizes regressions. For wave 1 backfill we suggest a 14-day overlap period where traffic is shadowed to both systems while we collect rerank telemetry.
>

Adding the specific smoke tests we discussed:
- Quality checks: precision@5 against the golden set, MRR for known intents, and an automated A/B that runs for 48 hours comparing CTR on merchant-surface results.
- Performance checks: 99th percentile latency under load test (target <120ms token-gen), and end-to-end query time under peacetime QPS.
- Rollback criteria: any decrease >6% in the primary metric (precision@5) triggers an automatic rollback to fallback ranker.

I've attached the sample eval set (rerank_eval_samples_v3.csv) and the vectorstore compatibility matrix (vectorstore_compat_matrix.pdf) with inline notes. Samir, can you confirm who on your infra side will be our point for KMS and network peering? Also flag any procurement constraints for Reserved capacity if you need predictable throughput guarantees.

-Neha
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: rerank_eval_samples_v3.csv; vectorstore_compat_matrix.pdf

Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank: Staged delta cutover and vectorstore compatibility checklist

Rafael / team — really helpful, thanks. Aisha and I reviewed the timeline and the test plan. Quick answers:

- Nimbus infra lead: Aisha Thomas (cc'd) will be primary for KMS/peering. She has access to our cloud account and can exchange details off-thread.
- QPS by shard: current peak QPS for transactions endpoints is ~1,400 QPS. We'll provide exact histograms for the last 30 days by EOD tomorrow.
- Procurement: Reserved capacity will need legal sign-off; please include an indicative monthly commit in the proposal so procurement has something to review.

We're comfortable with the 14-day shadow window as long as rollback criteria and the automation hooks are in place. Next meeting: let's do a technical kickoff on Monday at 10am PT to walk through the runbook and the smoke-test harness. Can you send a calendar invite?

Thanks — Samir
